blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解 HVAC 系統設計與確效的完整參考標準體系，包含 ICH、WHO、ISO、EU GMP、FDA 及各國工程標準
blocks.en: Understand the full set of reference standards behind HVAC system design and qualification, including ICH, WHO, ISO, EU GMP, FDA and national engineering standards

blocks.zh: 掌握 HVAC 領域常用縮寫與首字母縮略詞，建立專業溝通的共同語言基礎
blocks.en: Master the abbreviations and acronyms commonly used in the HVAC field, building a shared vocabulary for professional communication

blocks.zh: 理解關鍵 GMP 術語的正式定義，如 Acceptance Criteria、Critical Parameter、Direct Impact System 等
blocks.en: Understand the formal definitions of key GMP terms such as Acceptance Criteria, Critical Parameter and Direct Impact System

blocks.zh: 建立跨法規、跨標準的索引能力，能快速定位特定技術要求的原始出處
blocks.en: Build the ability to cross-reference regulations and standards, so you can quickly locate the original source of a specific technical requirement

blocks.en: Appendix 12 – References

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：參考文獻的架構分類
blocks.en: Core Concept: How the References Are Organized

blocks.zh: 本附錄的31項參考文獻可分為以下幾大類：
blocks.en: The 31 references in this appendix fall into the following main categories:

blocks.zh: 法規與指引（Regulatory）：ICH（Q7-Q10）、EU GMP Annex 1、PIC/S、US FDA CFR 21 — 這些是合規的「法源」
blocks.en: Regulations and guidance (Regulatory): ICH (Q7-Q10), EU GMP Annex 1, PIC/S, US FDA 21 CFR. These are the legal basis for compliance

blocks.zh: 國際標準（Standards）：ISO 14644 系列（潔淨室分級）、ISO 14698（生物污染控制）、ASTM E2500（設備驗證）
blocks.en: International standards (Standards): the ISO 14644 series (cleanroom classification), ISO 14698 (biocontamination control), ASTM E2500 (equipment verification)

blocks.zh: 工程實務（Engineering Practice）：ASHRAE（暖通空調工程師學會）、SMACNA（風管施工）、NEBB（環境平衡）、IEST（潔淨室測試）
blocks.en: Engineering practice (Engineering Practice): ASHRAE (heating, refrigerating and air-conditioning engineers), SMACNA (ductwork construction), NEBB (environmental balancing), IEST (cleanroom testing)

blocks.zh: ISPE 自有文件：Baseline Guides Vol.1-6、GAMP 校正管理
blocks.en: ISPE's own documents: Baseline Guides Vol. 1-6, GAMP calibration management

blocks.zh: 地區性標準：EN（歐洲過濾器標準）、CIBSE（英國建築設備）、NFPA（美國消防）
blocks.en: Regional standards: EN (European filter standards), CIBSE (UK building services), NFPA (US fire protection)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把這份參考文獻清單想像成一位 HVAC 工程師的「工具箱目錄」。就像木工需要不同的鋸子、鑿子和砂紙來完成不同工序，HVAC 設計師需要從不同來源找到對應的技術要求：
blocks.en: Think of this reference list as the catalogue of an HVAC engineer's toolbox. Just as a carpenter needs different saws, chisels and sandpaper for different steps, an HVAC designer has to find the relevant technical requirements in different sources:

blocks.zh: ICH/FDA/EU GMP = 建築法規（必須遵守）
blocks.en: ICH/FDA/EU GMP = building codes (must be complied with)

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 = 度量衡標準（怎麼量、怎麼分級）
blocks.en: ISO 14644 = weights and measures (how to measure and how to classify)

blocks.zh: ASHRAE/SMACNA = 施工手冊（怎麼做）
blocks.en: ASHRAE/SMACNA = construction manuals (how to do the work)

blocks.zh: ISPE Baseline = 藥廠特有的「最佳實務食譜」
blocks.en: ISPE Baseline = the pharma-specific "best-practice cookbook"

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理）是本指引反覆引用的核心概念。HVAC 系統的設計、確效與維護決策都應以風險為基礎，而非套用一成不變的規範。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management is a core concept cited repeatedly throughout this Guide. Decisions on HVAC design, qualification and maintenance should be risk-based rather than applying fixed rules unchanged.

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 系列是潔淨室設計的國際「通用語言」。Part 1（分級）和 Part 3（測試方法）是 HVAC 工程師最常查閱的兩個部分。
blocks.en: The ISO 14644 series is the international "common language" of cleanroom design. Part 1 (classification) and Part 3 (test methods) are the two parts HVAC engineers consult most often.

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500 提供了藥廠設備「設計 → 規格 → 驗證」的系統化方法，與 ISPE Baseline Vol.5 C&Q 指引高度互補。
blocks.en: ASTM E2500 provides a systematic "design, specification, verification" approach for pharmaceutical equipment, and is highly complementary to the ISPE Baseline Vol. 5 C&Q Guide.

blocks.zh: ASHRAE 與 SMACNA 的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Significance of ASHRAE and SMACNA

blocks.zh: ASHRAE（美國暖通空調工程師學會）提供的不僅是理論，更是可執行的試車程序和節能標準。特別是：
blocks.en: ASHRAE (American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers) offers more than theory; it provides executable commissioning procedures and energy-efficiency standards. In particular:

blocks.zh: Guideline 0-2005：試車流程的標準化方法，與 GMP commissioning 的精神一致
blocks.en: Guideline 0-2005: a standardized approach to the commissioning process, consistent with the spirit of GMP commissioning

blocks.zh: Standard 90.1：能源效率標準，在藥廠「永續製藥」趨勢下日益重要
blocks.en: Standard 90.1: an energy-efficiency standard, increasingly important as "sustainable pharma" gains momentum

blocks.zh: SMACNA 則提供風管施工、洩漏測試等「動手做」的技術規範。對於維護團隊和施工品質管理特別實用。
blocks.en: SMACNA provides hands-on technical specifications for ductwork construction, leak testing and similar work, and is particularly useful for maintenance teams and construction quality management.

blocks.zh: EN 1822 過濾器標準的重要性
blocks.en: Why the EN 1822 Filter Standard Matters

blocks.zh: EN 1822 系列（Part 1-5）是歐洲 HEPA/ULPA 過濾器的分級與測試標準。在 GMP 環境中，HEPA 過濾器的完整性測試（leak test）是確保潔淨室空氣品質的關鍵驗證項目。Part 4 的「掃描法」（Scan Method）是業界最常用的洩漏偵測方法。
blocks.en: The EN 1822 series (Parts 1-5) is the European standard for classifying and testing HEPA/ULPA filters. In a GMP environment, HEPA filter integrity testing (leak testing) is a key qualification item for ensuring cleanroom air quality. The "Scan Method" in Part 4 is the most widely used leak detection method in industry.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境：你正在為一座新的無菌充填廠房設計 HVAC 系統。客戶問你：「你的設計依據是什麼標準？」
blocks.en: Scenario: You are designing the HVAC system for a new aseptic filling facility. The client asks, "What standards is your design based on?"

blocks.zh: 建議回答架構：
blocks.en: Suggested answer structure:

blocks.zh: 法規要求：EU GMP Annex 1（潔淨室等級定義）+ FDA Aseptic Guidance（無菌製程要求）
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements: EU GMP Annex 1 (cleanroom grade definitions) + FDA Aseptic Guidance (aseptic process requirements)

blocks.zh: 分級標準：ISO 14644-1（粒子分級）+ ISO 14644-3（測試方法）
blocks.en: Classification standards: ISO 14644-1 (particle classification) + ISO 14644-3 (test methods)

blocks.zh: 工程實務：ASHRAE Handbooks（系統設計）+ SMACNA（風管施工）+ IEST RP-CC006.3（潔淨室測試）
blocks.en: Engineering practice: ASHRAE Handbooks (system design) + SMACNA (ductwork construction) + IEST RP-CC006.3 (cleanroom testing)

blocks.zh: 藥廠專用：ISPE Baseline Vol.3（無菌製造設施）+ 本 HVAC 指引
blocks.en: Pharma-specific: ISPE Baseline Vol. 3 (Sterile Product Manufacturing Facilities) + this HVAC Guide

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何 ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) 對 HVAC 系統設計如此重要？風險管理如何影響空調分區決策？
blocks.en: Why is ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) so important for HVAC system design? How does risk management influence HVAC zoning decisions?

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1 和 EU GMP Annex 1 在潔淨室分級上有什麼差異？為何需要同時參照兩者？
blocks.en: How do ISO 14644-1 and EU GMP Annex 1 differ in cleanroom classification? Why do you need to refer to both?

blocks.zh: 如果你要對 HEPA 過濾器進行完整性測試，應該參照 EN 1822 的哪一個 Part？為什麼 Scan Method 是首選？
blocks.en: If you need to perform an integrity test on a HEPA filter, which Part of EN 1822 should you refer to? Why is the Scan Method the preferred choice?

blocks.zh: Appendix 13 – Glossary（附錄13 – 詞彙表）
blocks.en: Appendix 13 – Glossary

blocks.zh: 19.1 Abbreviations（縮寫）
blocks.en: 19.1 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：組織縮寫分類
blocks.en: Core Concept: Categories of Organization Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 這些縮寫可以按功能分為幾大類，幫助你快速定位：
blocks.en: These abbreviations can be grouped by function to help you find them quickly:

blocks.zh: 藥品法規機構：FDA（美國食藥署）、EMEA（歐洲藥品管理局）、ICH（國際醫藥法規協和會）、PIC/S（國際藥品稽查協約組織）、WHO（世界衛生組織）
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical regulatory bodies: FDA (US Food and Drug Administration), EMEA (European Medicines Agency), ICH (International Council for Harmonisation), PIC/S (Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme), WHO (World Health Organization)

blocks.zh: 工程標準組織：ASHRAE（美國暖通空調工程師學會）、SMACNA（北美板金與空調承包商協會）、NEBB（美國環境平衡局）、IEST（環境科學與技術研究所）
blocks.en: Engineering standards organizations: ASHRAE (American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers), SMACNA (Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Contractors' National Association), NEBB (National Environmental Balancing Bureau), IEST (Institute of Environmental Sciences and Technology)

blocks.zh: 國際/國家標準：ISO（國際標準化組織）、ANSI（美國國家標準學會）、ASTM（美國測試與材料學會）、NEMA（美國電氣製造商協會）
blocks.en: International/national standards: ISO (International Organization for Standardization), ANSI (American National Standards Institute), ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials), NEMA (National Electrical Manufacturers Association)

blocks.zh: 安全與環保：OSHA（職業安全與衛生署）、EPA（環境保護署）、NFPA（美國消防協會）、COSHH（危害物質管控，英國）
blocks.en: Safety and environment: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), COSHH (Control of Substances Hazardous to Health, UK)

blocks.zh: 藥廠專業：ISPE（國際製藥工程學會）、USGBC/WGBC（綠建築委員會）
blocks.en: Pharma-specific: ISPE (International Society for Pharmaceutical Engineering), USGBC/WGBC (Green Building Councils)

blocks.zh: 在藥廠 HVAC 專案中，你最常接觸的組織縮寫是：
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical HVAC project, the organization abbreviations you will meet most often are:

blocks.zh: ISPE — 本指引的發行者，藥廠工程的權威來源
blocks.en: ISPE – publisher of this Guide, the authoritative source for pharmaceutical engineering

blocks.zh: ASHRAE — 所有 HVAC 工程設計的技術基礎
blocks.en: ASHRAE – the technical foundation of all HVAC engineering design

blocks.zh: ISO — 潔淨室分級的國際標準
blocks.en: ISO – the international standards for cleanroom classification

blocks.zh: FDA/EU GMP — 法規合規的兩大支柱
blocks.en: FDA/EU GMP – the two pillars of regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 記住：藥廠 HVAC 是「GMP 法規」+「工程標準」的交叉領域，兩邊都要熟。
blocks.en: Remember: pharmaceutical HVAC sits at the intersection of "GMP regulations" and "engineering standards", and you need to know both sides well.

blocks.zh: 19.2 Acronyms（首字母縮略詞）
blocks.en: 19.2 Acronyms

blocks.zh: 核心概念：技術縮略詞分類與中文翻譯
blocks.en: Core Concept: Categories of Technical Acronyms

blocks.zh: 這些縮略詞涵蓋了 HVAC 設計、GMP 品質與工程管理的方方面面。以下按主題分組並提供中文翻譯：
blocks.en: These acronyms cover every aspect of HVAC design, GMP quality and engineering management. They are grouped by topic below, with a plain-language explanation of each:

blocks.zh: HVAC 核心系統：
blocks.en: Core HVAC systems:

blocks.zh: AHU（空調箱 / 空氣處理單元）— HVAC 系統的核心設備
blocks.en: AHU (air handling unit) – the core equipment of an HVAC system

blocks.zh: HEPA（高效微粒空氣過濾器）— 效率 ≥99.97%，0.3μm 粒子
blocks.en: HEPA (high-efficiency particulate air filter) – efficiency ≥99.97% at 0.3 µm particles

blocks.zh: ULPA（超低穿透空氣過濾器）— 效率 ≥99.999%，0.12μm 粒子
blocks.en: ULPA (ultra-low penetration air filter) – efficiency ≥99.999% at 0.12 µm particles

blocks.zh: FFU（風機過濾單元）— 將風扇與 HEPA 整合的獨立單元
blocks.en: FFU (fan filter unit) – a self-contained unit integrating a fan and a HEPA filter

blocks.zh: UDAF（單向氣流）— 即過去稱為 Laminar Flow 的概念
blocks.en: UDAF (unidirectional airflow) – the concept formerly called laminar flow

blocks.zh: VAV（可變風量）— 節能型風量控制方式
blocks.en: VAV (variable air volume) – an energy-saving airflow control method

blocks.zh: CV/CVD（定風量/定風量擋板）
blocks.en: CV/CVD (constant volume / constant volume damper)

blocks.zh: 控制與監測：
blocks.en: Control and monitoring:

blocks.zh: BMS（建築管理系統）— 監控環境條件的核心平台
blocks.en: BMS (building management system) – the core platform for monitoring environmental conditions

blocks.zh: BAS（建築自動化系統）— 與 BMS 概念相近
blocks.en: BAS (building automation system) – a concept close to BMS

blocks.zh: DCS（分散控制系統）
blocks.en: DCS (distributed control system)

blocks.zh: DDC（直接數位控制）
blocks.en: DDC (direct digital control)

blocks.zh: PLC（可程式邏輯控制器）
blocks.en: PLC (programmable logic controller)

blocks.zh: SCADA（監控與資料擷取系統）
blocks.en: SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition)

blocks.zh: EMS（環境監測系統）
blocks.en: EMS (environmental monitoring system)

blocks.zh: PI/PID（比例積分/比例積分微分控制）— 溫濕度控制的基本演算法
blocks.en: PI/PID (proportional-integral / proportional-integral-derivative control) – the basic algorithms for temperature and humidity control

blocks.zh: GMP 品質相關：
blocks.en: GMP quality-related:

blocks.zh: GMP/CGMP（良好製造規範/現行良好製造規範）
blocks.en: GMP/CGMP (good manufacturing practice / current good manufacturing practice)

blocks.zh: GEP（良好工程實務）
blocks.en: GEP (good engineering practice)

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）
blocks.en: CQA (critical quality attribute)

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）
blocks.en: CPP (critical process parameter)

blocks.zh: QRM（品質風險管理）
blocks.en: QRM (quality risk management)

blocks.zh: QA（品質保證）
blocks.en: QA (quality assurance)

blocks.zh: SOP（標準作業程序）
blocks.en: SOP (standard operating procedure)

blocks.zh: CIP（就地清洗）
blocks.en: CIP (clean in place)

blocks.zh: RABS（限制進出屏障系統）
blocks.en: RABS (restricted access barrier system)

blocks.zh: VPHP（氣態過氧化氫）— 隔離器除污的主要方式
blocks.en: VPHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) – the main decontamination method for isolators

blocks.zh: 測試與驗證：
blocks.en: Testing and verification:

blocks.zh: FAT（工廠驗收測試）— 設備出廠前在製造商處進行
blocks.en: FAT (factory acceptance test) – performed at the manufacturer's site before the equipment ships

blocks.zh: SAT（現場驗收測試）— 設備安裝到現場後進行
blocks.en: SAT (site acceptance test) – performed after the equipment is installed on site

blocks.zh: TAB（測試、調整與平衡）— HVAC 試車的核心工作
blocks.en: TAB (testing, adjusting and balancing) – the core activity of HVAC commissioning

blocks.zh: DOP/PAO（鄰苯二甲酸二辛酯/聚α烯烴）— HEPA 過濾器洩漏測試用氣溶膠
blocks.en: DOP/PAO (dioctyl phthalate / polyalphaolefin) – aerosols used for HEPA filter leak testing

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式與效應分析）— QRM 常用工具
blocks.en: FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis) – a commonly used QRM tool

blocks.zh: RCFA（根本原因失效分析）
blocks.en: RCFA (root cause failure analysis)

blocks.zh: 量測與參數：
blocks.en: Measurements and parameters:

blocks.zh: DP（壓差）— 潔淨室區域隔離的核心參數
blocks.en: DP (differential pressure) – the core parameter for cleanroom zone segregation

blocks.zh: RH（相對濕度）
blocks.en: RH (relative humidity)

blocks.zh: MKT（平均動力學溫度）— 藥品穩定性評估用
blocks.en: MKT (mean kinetic temperature) – used in drug stability assessment

blocks.zh: CFU（菌落形成單位）— 微生物監測的基本單位
blocks.en: CFU (colony-forming unit) – the basic unit of microbiological monitoring

blocks.zh: MERV（最低效率報告值）— 過濾器效率分級
blocks.en: MERV (minimum efficiency reporting value) – filter efficiency rating

blocks.zh: MPPS（最高穿透粒徑）— 過濾器最難捕捉的粒子大小
blocks.en: MPPS (most penetrating particle size) – the particle size a filter captures least effectively

blocks.zh: PGR（粒子生成率）— 潔淨室換氣次數計算的關鍵輸入
blocks.en: PGR (particle generation rate) – a key input to cleanroom air change rate calculations

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位剛加入藥廠 HVAC 團隊的工程師，第一天開會就聽到：「AHU 的 VAV 需要透過 BMS 做 PID 控制，DP 讀數由 EMS 回饋，TAB 報告要在 SAT 前完成。」
blocks.en: Imagine you are an engineer who has just joined a pharmaceutical HVAC team, and at your first meeting you hear: "The AHU's VAV needs PID control through the BMS, the DP readings feed back from the EMS, and the TAB report has to be finished before SAT."

blocks.zh: 這就像第一次去日本旅行，到處都是看不懂的路標。這份縮略詞表就是你的「翻譯字典」— 先熟悉高頻詞彙，很快就能聽懂同事在說什麼。
blocks.en: It is like traveling to Japan for the first time and finding road signs you cannot read. This acronym list is your "translation dictionary": get familiar with the high-frequency terms first, and you will soon follow what your colleagues are saying.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：最高頻縮略詞 Top 15
blocks.en: Key Notes: Top 15 Most Frequent Acronyms

blocks.zh: 在日常 HVAC 專案溝通中，以下是你最常遇到的縮略詞：
blocks.en: In day-to-day HVAC project communication, these are the acronyms you will meet most often:

blocks.zh: AHU — 空調箱
blocks.en: AHU – air handling unit

blocks.zh: HEPA — 高效過濾器
blocks.en: HEPA – high-efficiency filter

blocks.zh: DP — 壓差
blocks.en: DP – differential pressure

blocks.zh: BMS — 建築管理系統
blocks.en: BMS – building management system

blocks.zh: TAB — 測試調整與平衡
blocks.en: TAB – testing, adjusting and balancing

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT — 工廠/現場驗收測試
blocks.en: FAT/SAT – factory/site acceptance test

blocks.zh: GMP/CGMP — 良好製造規範
blocks.en: GMP/CGMP – good manufacturing practice

blocks.zh: VAV — 可變風量
blocks.en: VAV – variable air volume

blocks.zh: RH — 相對濕度
blocks.en: RH – relative humidity

blocks.zh: SOP — 標準作業程序
blocks.en: SOP – standard operating procedure

blocks.zh: VFD — 變頻驅動器
blocks.en: VFD – variable frequency drive

blocks.zh: FFU — 風機過濾單元
blocks.en: FFU – fan filter unit

blocks.zh: EMS — 環境監測系統
blocks.en: EMS – environmental monitoring system

blocks.zh: UDAF — 單向氣流
blocks.en: UDAF – unidirectional airflow

blocks.zh: P&ID / AF&ID — 管路儀表圖/氣流儀表圖
blocks.en: P&ID / AF&ID – piping and instrumentation diagram / airflow and instrumentation diagram

blocks.zh: 19.3 Definitions（定義）
blocks.en: 19.3 Definitions

blocks.zh: 核心概念：關鍵定義中文翻譯與解析
blocks.en: Core Concept: Key Definitions Explained

blocks.zh: 以下將所有定義詞彙提供完整中文翻譯：
blocks.en: The definitions are explained in full below:

blocks.zh: Acceptance Criteria（允收標準）：可能影響產品品質的關鍵參數條件限值。注意：只有「關鍵」參數才需要納入允收標準。
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria: the limits on critical parameters that may affect product quality. Note: only "critical" parameters need to be included in acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: Action Limit（行動限值）：超出操作範圍的標準，需要有書面回應。
blocks.en: Action Limit: a criterion beyond the operating range that requires a documented response.

blocks.zh: Air Change Rate（換氣次數）：單位時間內空間總氣量被替換的次數。
blocks.en: Air Change Rate: the number of times the total air volume of a space is replaced per unit of time.

blocks.zh: AF&ID（氣流與儀表圖）：顯示 HVAC 儀表控制的圖面，標註 GMP 關鍵元件。
blocks.en: AF&ID (Airflow and Instrumentation Diagram): a drawing showing HVAC instrumentation and controls, with GMP-critical components identified.

blocks.zh: AFD（氣流圖）：示意圖，顯示空調箱服務的房間、風量平衡和壓差。
blocks.en: AFD (Airflow Diagram): a schematic showing the rooms served by an air handling unit, the airflow balance and the differential pressures.

blocks.zh: Alert Limit（警戒限值）：在達到行動限值前的預警通知標準。
blocks.en: Alert Limit: an early-warning criterion issued before the action limit is reached.

blocks.zh: Arrestance（捕集率）：過濾器移除合成粉塵的能力指標。
blocks.en: Arrestance: a measure of a filter's ability to remove synthetic dust.

blocks.zh: As-Built Drawings（竣工圖）：反映施工完成後實際狀況的圖面。
blocks.en: As-Built Drawings: drawings that reflect the actual condition after construction is complete.

blocks.zh: BMS（建築管理系統）：控制、監測與優化環境條件的電腦系統。
blocks.en: BMS (Building Management System): a computer system that controls, monitors and optimizes environmental conditions.

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更管制）：審查可能影響驗證狀態變更的正式系統。
blocks.en: Change Control: a formal system for reviewing changes that may affect the qualified state.

blocks.zh: Closed（封閉的）：不暴露於房間環境，能承受一定壓力或沖洗。
blocks.en: Closed: not exposed to the room environment, and able to withstand a certain pressure or flushing.

blocks.zh: Closed Process（封閉製程）：產品及接觸面與室內環境隔離的製程狀態。
blocks.en: Closed Process: a process state in which the product and its contact surfaces are isolated from the room environment.

blocks.zh: Commissioning（試車）：驗證並記錄設施系統性能符合既定目標的品質導向過程。
blocks.en: Commissioning: a quality-focused process of verifying and documenting that facility systems perform to the stated objectives.

blocks.zh: 關鍵品質術語群組
blocks.en: Key Quality Terms

blocks.zh: Critical Component（關鍵組件）：其運作、接觸、資料、控制、警報或故障可能直接影響產品品質的組件。
blocks.en: Critical Component: a component whose operation, contact, data, control, alarm or failure may directly affect product quality.

blocks.zh: Critical Location（關鍵位置）：產品暴露處，或已清潔之產品接觸面暴露處。
blocks.en: Critical Location: a location where the product is exposed, or where a cleaned product-contact surface is exposed.

blocks.zh: Critical Parameter（關鍵參數）：直接影響藥品特性或雜質的製程參數。
blocks.en: Critical Parameter: a process parameter that directly affects the characteristics or impurities of the drug product.

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameter / CPP（關鍵製程參數）：其變異會影響品質屬性的參數，即使受控仍為「關鍵」。
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameter / CPP: a parameter whose variability affects a quality attribute; it remains "critical" even when it is under control.

blocks.zh: Critical Quality Attribute / CQA（關鍵品質屬性）：需被控制以確保產品品質的物理、化學、生物或微生物特性。
blocks.en: Critical Quality Attribute / CQA: a physical, chemical, biological or microbiological property that must be controlled to ensure product quality.

blocks.zh: 這五個「Critical」相關定義是 HVAC 系統影響評估（Impact Assessment）的基礎。HVAC 系統是否為 Direct Impact System，取決於它是否控制任何 Critical Parameter 或 CQA。
blocks.en: These five "Critical" definitions are the basis of HVAC system impact assessment. Whether an HVAC system is a Direct Impact System depends on whether it controls any Critical Parameter or CQA.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Direct vs. Indirect Impact System
blocks.en: Key Notes: Direct vs. Indirect Impact System

blocks.zh: Direct Impact System（直接影響系統）：預期會直接影響產品品質的系統。除了需遵循 GEP，還需接受 Qualification（確效），包含強化審查、管控與測試。
blocks.en: Direct Impact System: a system expected to have a direct impact on product quality. In addition to following GEP, it must be qualified, including enhanced review, control and testing.

blocks.zh: Indirect Impact System（間接影響系統）：不會直接影響產品品質，但通常支援直接影響系統。只需遵循 GEP 即可。
blocks.en: Indirect Impact System: a system that does not have a direct impact on product quality but typically supports a Direct Impact System. It only needs to follow GEP.

blocks.zh: 這個分類決定了 HVAC 系統各組件的驗證深度與文件要求。例如：服務無菌充填區的 AHU 是 Direct Impact，而服務辦公區的 AHU 是 Indirect Impact。
blocks.en: This classification determines the depth of qualification and the documentation required for each component of the HVAC system. For example, an AHU serving an aseptic filling area is Direct Impact, while an AHU serving an office area is Indirect Impact.

blocks.zh: 設計相關術語群組
blocks.en: Design-Related Terms

blocks.zh: Design For Impact（為影響而設計）：在設計開發初期就考慮系統運作時的影響。
blocks.en: Design For Impact: considering the impact of system operation at the very start of design development.

blocks.zh: Design Point（設計點）：基礎設計中的標稱設定點，加減容差值。
blocks.en: Design Point: the nominal set point in the basis of design, plus or minus the tolerance.

blocks.zh: Design Qualification / DQ（設計確效）：書面驗證提議的設計適合預定用途。
blocks.en: Design Qualification / DQ: documented verification that the proposed design is suitable for the intended purpose.

blocks.zh: Design Target（設計目標）：比允收標準更保守的值，供設計師確保系統有足夠能力。注意：設計目標不應用於確效！
blocks.en: Design Target: a value more conservative than the acceptance criteria, used by designers to ensure the system has sufficient capability. Note: design targets should not be used for qualification!

blocks.zh: Design Tolerance（設計容差）：正常操作範圍的預期上下限。
blocks.en: Design Tolerance: the expected upper and lower limits of normal operation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Action Limit vs. Alert Limit
blocks.en: Analogy: Action Limit vs. Alert Limit

blocks.zh: 想像你在高速公路開車：
blocks.en: Imagine you are driving on a highway:

blocks.zh: Operating Range（操作範圍） = 時速 90-110 公里（正常行駛區間）
blocks.en: Operating Range = 90-110 km/h (the normal driving range)

blocks.zh: Alert Limit（警戒限值） = 時速 115 公里（儀表板開始閃燈提醒你）
blocks.en: Alert Limit = 115 km/h (the dashboard starts flashing to warn you)

blocks.zh: Action Limit（行動限值） = 時速 120 公里（超過就要被開罰單，需要書面記錄）
blocks.en: Action Limit = 120 km/h (go over this and you get a ticket, so it needs to be documented)

blocks.zh: Design Point（設計點） = 時速 100 公里（設計師期望的最佳巡航速度）
blocks.en: Design Point = 100 km/h (the best cruising speed the designer intended)

blocks.zh: 在 HVAC 中，Alert Limit 是「早期預警」，讓你有機會在真正出問題前修正偏移。
blocks.en: In HVAC, the Alert Limit is an "early warning" that gives you a chance to correct a drift before a real problem occurs.

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統特有術語
blocks.en: HVAC-Specific Terms

blocks.zh: Exfiltration（外滲）：空氣因壓差從門縫等處「漏出」房間。
blocks.en: Exfiltration: air "leaking out" of a room through door gaps and the like because of a pressure difference.

blocks.zh: Infiltration（滲入）：外部空氣因壓差「漏入」房間。在潔淨室中必須防止非受控空氣滲入。
blocks.en: Infiltration: outside air "leaking into" a room because of a pressure difference. In a cleanroom, uncontrolled air infiltration must be prevented.

blocks.zh: Exhaust Air（排氣）：被機械排出且不再回收利用的空氣。
blocks.en: Exhaust Air: air that is mechanically removed and not reused.

blocks.zh: Return Air（回風）：被機械排出但回到空調系統再循環利用的空氣。
blocks.en: Return Air: air that is mechanically removed but returned to the air-conditioning system for recirculation.

blocks.zh: Supply Air（送風）：經過調節後機械送入房間的空氣。CFM ÷ 0.6 = CMH。
blocks.en: Supply Air: conditioned air mechanically delivered into a room. CFM ÷ 0.6 = CMH.

blocks.zh: Plenum（靜壓箱/氣壓室）：利用靜壓差（非風速）分配空氣的封閉空間，可位於地板下、天花板上或垂直管道中。
blocks.en: Plenum: an enclosed space that distributes air by static pressure difference (not air velocity); it can be under the floor, above the ceiling or in a vertical duct.

blocks.zh: Latent Heat（潛熱）：物質相變時釋放或吸收的能量。HVAC 中用於從濕空氣中冷凝水分。
blocks.en: Latent Heat: the energy released or absorbed when a substance changes phase. In HVAC it is used to condense moisture out of humid air.

blocks.zh: Psychrometry（濕空氣學）：研究氣體-蒸氣混合物性質的學問。焓濕圖（psychrometric chart）是 HVAC 設計的基本工具。
blocks.en: Psychrometry: the study of the properties of gas-vapor mixtures. The psychrometric chart is a basic tool of HVAC design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：DOP 已被 PAO 取代
blocks.en: Key Notes: DOP Has Been Replaced by PAO

blocks.zh: DOP（鄰苯二甲酸二辛酯）過去是 HEPA 過濾器完整性測試的標準氣溶膠材料，但因被認為具致癌性，已被 PAO（聚α烯烴）取代。但業界仍習慣稱之為「DOP 測試」，現在理解為「Dispersed Oil Particulate」的縮寫。
blocks.en: DOP (dioctyl phthalate) was formerly the standard aerosol material for HEPA filter integrity testing, but because it was considered carcinogenic it has been replaced by PAO (polyalphaolefin). Industry still habitually calls it the "DOP test", now understood as an abbreviation for "Dispersed Oil Particulate".

blocks.zh: 這是一個很好的例子，說明為何理解術語的歷史背景很重要 — 如果你在現場聽到「做 DOP test」，實際使用的材料幾乎肯定是 PAO。
blocks.en: This is a good example of why understanding the history of a term matters: if you hear someone on site say "doing a DOP test", the material actually used is almost certainly PAO.

blocks.zh: 過濾器與粒子相關術語
blocks.en: Filter and Particle Terms

blocks.zh: HEPA Filter（高效微粒空氣過濾器）：對 0.3 μm 粒子效率 >99.97%。這是無菌區的基本配備。
blocks.en: HEPA Filter (high-efficiency particulate air filter): efficiency >99.97% at 0.3 µm particles. This is the basic equipment of sterile areas.

blocks.zh: ULPA Filter（超低穿透空氣過濾器）：對 ≥0.12 μm 粒子效率 ≥99.999%。用於需要更高潔淨度的特殊場景。
blocks.en: ULPA Filter (ultra-low penetration air filter): efficiency ≥99.999% at ≥0.12 µm particles. Used in special applications requiring higher cleanliness.

blocks.zh: Dust Spot Efficiency（塵斑效率）：評估過濾器去除合成粉塵的能力。
blocks.en: Dust Spot Efficiency: evaluates a filter's ability to remove synthetic dust.

blocks.zh: Arrestance（捕集率）：與 Dust Spot Efficiency 類似，但通常用於較大粒子。
blocks.en: Arrestance: similar to Dust Spot Efficiency, but generally used for larger particles.

blocks.zh: MPPS（最高穿透粒徑）：過濾器最難捕捉的粒子大小，通常約 0.1-0.3 μm。
blocks.en: MPPS (most penetrating particle size): the particle size that a filter captures least effectively, typically about 0.1-0.3 µm.

blocks.zh: "Nearly Massless" Particles（幾乎無質量的粒子）：<0.5 μm 的粒子，佔室外空氣總質量 <1%，但佔粒子總數量的大部分。
blocks.en: "Nearly Massless" Particles: particles <0.5 µm, which make up <1% of the total mass of outdoor air but most of the total particle count.

blocks.zh: Particle Count（粒子計數）：包含活性（viable）與非活性（non-viable）粒子。PCF × 35.3 = 每立方公尺粒子數。
blocks.en: Particle Count: includes viable and non-viable particles. PCF × 35.3 = particles per cubic meter.

blocks.zh: PGR（粒子生成率）：空間內製程與人員每單位時間產生的粒子量，是計算所需換氣次數的關鍵輸入。
blocks.en: PGR (particle generation rate): the quantity of particles generated per unit time by the process and personnel in a space; a key input for calculating the required air change rate.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Grade 的雙重標準
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Dual Standard for Grade

blocks.zh: Grade（等級）的定義提到了一個關鍵差異：ISO 14644-1 只定義「運轉中」(in operation) 的粒子限值，而 EU GMP 的 Grade A-D 同時要求「靜態」(at rest) 和「運轉中」兩種狀態的粒子限值。
blocks.en: The definition of Grade points to a key difference: ISO 14644-1 defines particle limits only for the "in operation" state, whereas EU GMP Grades A-D require particle limits in both the "at rest" and "in operation" states.

blocks.zh: 這意味著在歐盟法規環境下做 HVAC 設計，你需要確保系統在兩種狀態下都能達標 — 這對系統設計有直接影響。
blocks.en: This means that when designing HVAC under the EU regulatory framework, you must make sure the system meets the limits in both states, which has a direct impact on system design.

blocks.zh: 驗證與文件術語
blocks.en: Qualification and Documentation Terms

blocks.zh: Enhanced Design Review / EDR（強化設計審查）：在專案適當階段對工程設計進行的書面審查，確認符合運營與法規期望。
blocks.en: Enhanced Design Review / EDR: a documented review of the engineering design at an appropriate stage of the project, to confirm it meets operational and regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: Functional Design Specification / FDS（功能設計規格書）：描述 HVAC 如何達到允收標準的文件（房間等級、壓差、風量、恢復時間、過濾層級等）。
blocks.en: Functional Design Specification / FDS: a document describing how the HVAC system achieves the acceptance criteria (room classification, differential pressure, airflow, recovery time, filtration level and so on).

blocks.zh: GEP（良好工程實務）：在專案生命週期中應用的既定工程方法與標準，交付適當且具成本效益的解決方案。
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice): established engineering methods and standards applied throughout the project life cycle to deliver appropriate, cost-effective solutions.

blocks.zh: Process Validation（製程驗證）：建立書面證據，證明特定製程能一致地生產符合預定規格的產品。
blocks.en: Process Validation: establishing documented evidence that a specific process consistently produces a product meeting its predetermined specifications.

blocks.zh: Requirement Specifications（需求規格書）：詳細說明客戶對設施、設備、公用系統需求的文件。
blocks.en: Requirement Specifications: documents detailing the customer's requirements for facilities, equipment and utility systems.

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更管制）：審查可能影響驗證狀態變更的正式系統 — 任何 HVAC 系統的修改都必須經過此程序。
blocks.en: Change Control: a formal system for reviewing changes that may affect the qualified state. Any modification to an HVAC system must go through this procedure.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Closed Process
blocks.en: Analogy: Closed Process

blocks.zh: 想像一個密封的太空人頭盔（Closed Process）vs. 一個敞開的安全帽（Open Process）。太空人頭盔內的空氣完全與外界隔離，即使外面環境再惡劣也不影響裡面。藥廠的 Closed Process 也是同樣概念 — 產品和產品接觸面被密封設備完全包裹，不與房間環境接觸。
blocks.en: Imagine a sealed astronaut helmet (Closed Process) vs. an open hard hat (Open Process). The air inside the astronaut helmet is completely isolated from the outside, so no matter how harsh the environment outside, the inside is unaffected. A pharmaceutical Closed Process follows the same idea: the product and product-contact surfaces are fully enclosed by sealed equipment and do not touch the room environment.

blocks.zh: 這直接影響 HVAC 設計：如果製程是 Closed 的，對房間潔淨等級的要求可以較低；如果是 Open 的，房間必須達到更高的潔淨等級。
blocks.en: This directly affects HVAC design: if the process is Closed, the room cleanliness requirement can be lower; if it is Open, the room must meet a higher cleanliness grade.

blocks.zh: 公式參考：換氣次數計算
blocks.en: Formula Reference: Air Change Rate Calculation

blocks.zh:
Air Change Rate (ACR) = Supply Air Volume (CFM) x 60
                        ─────────────────────────────
                           Room Volume (cubic feet)

換氣次數 = 送風量 (CFM) x 60 / 房間體積 (立方英尺)

單位轉換：
  CFM / 0.6 = CMH (cubic meters per hour)
  PCF x 35.3 = particles per cubic meter
blocks.en:
Air Change Rate (ACR) = Supply Air Volume (CFM) x 60
                        ─────────────────────────────
                           Room Volume (cubic feet)

Air change rate = Supply air volume (CFM) x 60 / Room volume (cubic feet)

Unit conversion:
  CFM / 0.6 = CMH (cubic meters per hour)
  PCF x 35.3 = particles per cubic meter

blocks.zh: 情境：在 HVAC 系統的影響評估（Impact Assessment）會議上，品質部門問你：「為什麼送風系統是 Direct Impact，而排風系統是 Indirect Impact？」
blocks.en: Scenario: At an HVAC system impact assessment meeting, the Quality unit asks you: "Why is the supply air system Direct Impact while the exhaust air system is Indirect Impact?"

blocks.zh: 建議回答：根據本指引的定義，Direct Impact System 是「預期會直接影響產品品質」的系統。送風系統（Supply Air System）直接提供經過 HEPA 過濾的潔淨空氣到製造區，控制著 Critical Parameter（溫度、濕度、粒子等級）。排風系統（Exhaust Air System）將空氣排出且不回收，它支援送風系統維持正壓差，但不直接接觸或影響產品品質，因此屬於 Indirect Impact。
blocks.en: Suggested answer: Under this Guide's definition, a Direct Impact System is one that is "expected to have a direct impact on product quality". The Supply Air System delivers HEPA-filtered clean air directly to the manufacturing area and controls the Critical Parameters (temperature, humidity, particle level and so on). The Exhaust Air System removes air without recirculating it; it supports the supply air system in maintaining positive differential pressure but does not directly contact or affect product quality, so it is classed as Indirect Impact.

blocks.zh: 說明 Design Target、Design Tolerance、Acceptance Criteria 和 Action Limit 之間的層級關係。在 HVAC 系統中，以溫度控制為例說明各層級的數值可能是什麼？
blocks.en: Explain the hierarchy among Design Target, Design Tolerance, Acceptance Criteria and Action Limit. Using temperature control as an example, what might the values at each level be in an HVAC system?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CPP 的定義特別強調「即使受控仍為關鍵」？這對 HVAC 系統的變更管制有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why does the CPP definition specifically stress "remains critical even when under control"? What does this imply for change control of HVAC systems?

blocks.zh: Exfiltration 和 Infiltration 如何影響潔淨室的壓差管理？如果一間 Grade B 房間發生 Infiltration，可能的後果是什麼？
blocks.en: How do Exfiltration and Infiltration affect differential pressure management in a cleanroom? If infiltration occurs in a Grade B room, what could the consequences be?

blocks.zh: 比較 HEPA 和 ULPA 過濾器的效率規格。在什麼情況下需要使用 ULPA 而非 HEPA？
blocks.en: Compare the efficiency specifications of HEPA and ULPA filters. In what situations would you need ULPA rather than HEPA?

blocks.zh: Closed Process 和 Open Process 對 HVAC 設計要求有什麼差異？舉一個 CDMO 中常見的例子。
blocks.en: How do Closed Process and Open Process differ in their HVAC design requirements? Give a common example from a CDMO.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 參考文獻體系：HVAC 系統設計涉及 31 項標準，橫跨法規（ICH/FDA/EU GMP）、國際標準（ISO 14644）、工程實務（ASHRAE/SMACNA）與藥廠專用指引（ISPE Baseline），專案團隊需要跨領域的標準知識
blocks.en: Reference framework: HVAC system design involves 31 standards spanning regulations (ICH/FDA/EU GMP), international standards (ISO 14644), engineering practice (ASHRAE/SMACNA) and pharma-specific guidance (ISPE Baseline), so project teams need cross-disciplinary knowledge of standards

blocks.zh: 組織與縮寫：40+ 個組織縮寫和 100+ 個技術縮略詞構成了 HVAC 專業溝通的「共同語言」。最高頻的包括 AHU、HEPA、DP、BMS、TAB、FAT/SAT
blocks.en: Organizations and abbreviations: 40+ organization abbreviations and 100+ technical acronyms form the "common language" of professional HVAC communication. The most frequent include AHU, HEPA, DP, BMS, TAB and FAT/SAT

blocks.zh: Critical 術語家族：Critical Component、Critical Location、Critical Parameter、CPP、CQA 是系統影響評估的基礎，決定了哪些 HVAC 元件需要接受 Qualification
blocks.en: The Critical term family: Critical Component, Critical Location, Critical Parameter, CPP and CQA are the basis of system impact assessment and determine which HVAC components must be qualified

blocks.zh: Direct vs. Indirect Impact：這個分類是 HVAC 驗證策略的核心 — Direct Impact 系統需要 GEP + Qualification，Indirect Impact 只需 GEP
blocks.en: Direct vs. Indirect Impact: this classification is the core of the HVAC qualification strategy. Direct Impact systems need GEP + Qualification, while Indirect Impact systems need only GEP

blocks.zh: 設計參數層級：Design Target < Design Tolerance < Operating Range < Alert Limit < Action Limit < Acceptance Criteria — 這個層級關係適用於所有 HVAC 關鍵參數
blocks.en: Hierarchy of design parameters: Design Target < Design Tolerance < Operating Range < Alert Limit < Action Limit < Acceptance Criteria. This hierarchy applies to all critical HVAC parameters

blocks.zh: DOP 已更名為 PAO 測試：由於 DOP 的致癌疑慮，現在使用 PAO（聚α烯烴）作為 HEPA 過濾器完整性測試的氣溶膠材料，但「DOP 測試」的名稱仍沿用
blocks.en: DOP is now the PAO test: because of concerns that DOP is carcinogenic, PAO (polyalphaolefin) is now used as the aerosol material for HEPA filter integrity testing, but the name "DOP test" is still in use

blocks.zh: Grade 的雙重要求：EU GMP 的 Grade A-D 同時要求靜態與運轉中的粒子限值，比 ISO 14644-1 更嚴格，這對 HVAC 系統設計有直接影響
blocks.en: The dual requirement for Grade: EU GMP Grades A-D require particle limits at rest and in operation, which is stricter than ISO 14644-1 and has a direct impact on HVAC system design
